About:

Learn how to set up your Amazon seller account in just five minutes with James, a former Amazon program manager who successfully launched his own Amazon FBA business. In this comprehensive Amazon seller account setup tutorial, James shares his journey from being laid off to creating Bogeies and Beers, his profitable Amazon passion product. James references Travis and the Amazon Passion Product Formula course as essential resources for aspiring Amazon sellers looking to start selling on Amazon and build a successful ecommerce business.

Topics Covered in This Amazon FBA Tutorial:
• How to sign up for an Amazon seller account at sell.amazon.com and begin your Amazon FBA journey
• Differences between Amazon Professional Seller account and Individual Seller account for selling on Amazon
• Recommended Amazon seller account setup for entrepreneurs planning to sell over 40 units per month
• Step-by-step guide to logging in or creating a new Amazon account for your online business
• Selecting your business location and selling from outside the US as an international Amazon seller
• Choosing your business entity type for your Amazon FBA business including LLC, DBA, or individual seller registration
• Why an LLC protects your personal assets when starting an Amazon business and when a DBA might be sufficient for small Amazon sellers
• How to set up your EIN Employer Identification Number and get a free tax ID from the IRS for your ecommerce business
• Providing proof of identity and documentation for Amazon seller account verification and approval
• Setting up bank account information, routing numbers, and credit card information for your Amazon seller account
• Choosing your Amazon store name and updating it later as your Amazon FBA business grows
• Understanding UPC codes and how to get new UPC codes from GS1.org for your Amazon products
• Information on diversity certifications for minority, women, veteran, or LGBTQ-owned Amazon businesses
• How to confirm brand ownership when selling your own product on Amazon and launching private label products
• Completing the final identity verification steps including uploading passport photos and potential video verification for Amazon seller approval
• James experience launching Bogeies and Beers, a golf tee-based drinking game, and earning over thirty thousand dollars selling on Amazon FBA
• Recommendations for learning from expert Amazon sellers like Travis and using his free 10-hour Amazon seller course for beginners
• Tips for starting a passion product business, selling products on Amazon, and scaling a profitable Amazon FBA business
